name: Trap hat rolls
desc: Stage-harvested half-time 808 trap kit: boomy kick on 1 and the 7th eighth, clap on 3, hats that stutter into ply rolls with a slow brightness sweep and 8-bar double-time fills.

code.sparse: stack(s("bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~").bank("RolandTR808").shape(.25).gain(${gain}*.9), s("~ ~ ~ ~ cp ~ ~ ~").bank("RolandTR808").room(sine.range(.15,.4).slow(32)).gain(${gain}*.7), s("hh ~ hh ~ hh ~ hh ~").bank("RolandTR808").ply("<1 1 2 1>").gain(.3).mask("<1 1 1 0>")).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("bd ~ ~ bd ~ bd bd ~").bank("RolandTR808").shape(.35).gain(${gain}), s("bd(3,8,<0 2 4 6>)").bank("RolandTR808").gain(${gain}*.3), s("~ ~ ~ ~ cp ~ ~ ~").bank("RolandTR808").room(${room}).gain(${gain}*.85), s("hh*8").bank("RolandTR808").ply("<1 2 1 3>").gain("[.55 .34 .5 .34]*2").lpf(sine.range(${bright}*.8, ${bright}*1.4).slow(16)).every(4, x=>x.fast(2)).fast(${rate}), s("~ ~ ~ oh ~ ~ ~ ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(.4).mask("<1 1 1 0 1 1 0 1>")).orbit(1).play()
